name: What is the process for professional grease clog removal?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for professional grease clog removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional grease clog removal typically begins with a diagnostic assessment to locate and evaluate the clog's severity. For stubborn grease, our technicians at CG Plumbing Solutions often use hydro-jetting, which employs high-pressure water streams to thoroughly scour the inside of pipes, breaking up and flushing away grease and other debris. This method is highly effective and safe for most plumbing systems. The process ensures a complete clearing of the blockage, restoring optimal drainage and preventing recurrence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional grease clog removal involves a diagnostic assessment followed by hydro-jetting, which uses high-pressure water to thoroughly clear pipes.
